custom_logic_notes: ICT-based EA with two strategies: Silver Bullet (time-gated 10:00-11:00 NY session) and 2022 Model (no time gate). Both require 4 confluences: liquidity sweep/inducement, Market Structure Shift (MSS), Fair Value Gap (FVG), and New Day/New Week Opening Gap (NDOG/NWOG). Entry via OTE (Fibonacci 0.618-0.786 zone) or FVG midpoint. Partial close system persists TP state via GlobalVariables. ATR handle is created and destroyed on every CheckNDOG_NWOG call (inefficient). BE_PlusPips uses digitsFactor for pip adjustment. TrailingSL uses digitsFactor. Silver Bullet uses liquiditySwept with same bias direction; 2022Model uses inducement with opposite bias for liquidity sweep check.
python_conversion_notes: Critical: (1) GlobalVariable persistence for partial TP state must be reimplemented with a state dict or database. (2) ATR handle leak - created/destroyed every tick in CheckNDOG_NWOG - should be cached in Python. (3) ICT concepts (FVG, MSS, liquidity sweep, NDOG/NWOG) are custom heuristics that need direct translation - FVG detection logic has a bug (checks rates[i].high < rates[i-2].low for bullish FVG which is inverted). (4) positionInfo.SelectByMagic is used as both a gate check and position selector - Python needs a positions filter by magic number. (5) The digitsFactor=10 adjustment for 5-digit brokers must be preserved. (6) BE_PlusPips and TrailingSL calculations use pointValue*digitsFactor which equals 'pips'. (7) Partial close logic modifies position volume mid-trade - requires tracking remaining volume. (8) Daily drawdown reset logic uses calendar day comparison. (9) Filling mode hardcoded to FOK (0) - may need broker-specific adjustment.
